title: Camareiro(a)

title: Coordenador de manutenção deck machinery (equipamentos de convés)
description: Descrição da vaga Buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de Deck Machinery (Equipamentos de Convés) para integrar nossa equipe e liderar uma área centralizada de suporte técnico e reparo de equipamentos de convés, atendendo toda a frota da BRAM Offshore. O profissional será responsável por gerir e desenvolver a equipe técnica, atuar como ponto focal entre Manutenção e Operações, definir prioridades e escopos de reparo, avaliar laudos e relatórios técnicos, analisar custos e indicadores, e conduzir análises de causa raiz e tratativas de falha em guinchos, guindastes subsea e sistemas de ancoragem. Também prestará suporte técnico avançado aos processos de PCM e atuará em interface com áreas internas e especialistas. Responsabilidades e atribuições: Gerir, instruir e desenvolver a equipe técnica na realização da manutenção dos equipamentos de Deck Machinery Ser o ponto focal entre Manutenção e Operações em todos os processos relacionados ao setor Definir escopos, prioridades e agenda dos técnicos alinhado à estratégia de manutenção da companhia Avaliar as solicitações de reparo dos ativos com base na estratégia de manutenção da companhia Distribuir as ordens de serviço de acordo com o nível de complexidade dos equipamentos Trabalhar no desenvolvimento de planos de manutenção e estratégias de diagnóstico em equipamentos de convés de diferentes fabricantes Avaliar laudos e relatórios de reparo e testes de equipamentos Analisar custos e controlar registros e cronogramas de manutenção de todos os equipamentos que compete à área Analisar os indicadores de manutenção e emitir relatórios Coordenar o fluxo de trabalho dos processos de Planejamento, Programação e Controle da Manutenção dos equipamentos de Deck Machinery (Guinchos e Guindastes subsea) assegurando o cumprimento das estratégias e metas Benefícios: Trabalho híbrido (4x presencial e 1x remoto) Plano de Saúde e Odontológico, extensivo aos dependentes Vale Alimentação/ Refeição Vale Transporte Previdência Privada Plataforma de cursos online para todos os colaboradores Plataforma para apoiar no cuidado a saúde mental Benefício de Academias e Plataforma de Incentivo a rotina saudável Sobre a empresa Procurando um desafio? Seja em terra ou no mar, você encontra esse desafio na Edison Chouest Offshore. Somos uma família de empresas voltadas para resultados e apaixonadas pela excelência. Estamos orgulhosos do mosaico de pessoas que nos torna o fornecedor líder mundial de serviços marítimos. A Bram Offshore Transportes Marítimos é uma empresa do Grupo Edison Chouest Offshore e especializada no transporte marítimo de apoio à indústria de petróleo e gás no Brasil. Desde a chegada da primeira embarcação do Grupo Chouest, em 1991, a frota em operação no Brasil vem aumentando, já contando com mais de 70 embarcações altamente especializadas, de última geração. Quer se juntar a nós e fazer parte do time de Manutenção?

title: Trainee de trading
description: Company Description Saturno Gás Trading e Soluções Ltda. is a Brazilian energy company dedicated to transforming and democratizing access to natural gas throughout the country. Operating as an independent gas trader, the company connects producers, distributors, and end-users to foster a more dynamic and competitive energy market. Saturno Gás combines commercial expertise, regulatory knowledge, and innovative trading solutions to help clients optimize costs, diversify supply, and seize new market opportunities. Guided by a mission to make natural gas more accessible and efficient, the company actively supports Brazil’s energy transition. A strong focus on transparency, operational excellence, and sustainability underpins its role in building a modern gas ecosystem and contributing to economic growth. Role Description The Trainee de Trading will support the trading team in day-to-day operations, including monitoring natural gas markets, analyzing price trends, and assisting in the execution and follow-up of trading strategies and contracts. This full-time, on-site role based in Rio de Janeiro, RJ involves collecting and organizing market data, preparing reports and presentations, and helping evaluate commercial opportunities and risks. The trainee will collaborate with senior traders and other internal areas to ensure accurate documentation, compliance with regulatory requirements, and efficient communication with counterparties. The role also includes learning trading systems and tools, supporting internal process improvements, and contributing to projects that enhance Saturno Gás’s commercial performance. Qualifications Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to interpret market data and financial information. Interest in energy markets, particularly natural gas, and willingness to learn trading concepts and regulatory frameworks. Proficiency with Excel and other data analysis tools; familiarity with Power Point or similar software for reporting. Clear written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese; reading and writing in English is highly beneficial. Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment, demonstrating organization, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills. Ongoing or completed bachelor’s degree in Economics, Engineering, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field. Availability to work on-site in Rio de Janeiro, RJ, on a full-time basis. Previous internship or academic projects in energy, commodities, finance, or consulting are a plus but not mandatory.
company: Saturno Gás Trading E Soluções Ltda

title: Email designer
description: About Lilo Social Lilo Social is a full-funnel e Commerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing. Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners. The Role As an Email Designer at Lilo Social, you will be the creative force behind high-converting email experiences for our portfolio of direct-to-consumer brands. You will transform strategic concepts into beautiful, mobile-optimized email designs that drive engagement, revenue, and long-term customer loyalty. Working closely with retention strategists and copywriters, you will craft email templates that balance brand aesthetics with performance-driven design principles. What Success Looks Like Consistently high email engagement rates (open rates, click rates) across your client portfolio through strong visual design Efficient production workflows that allow rapid iteration and testing of design variations Email designs that maintain brand consistency while optimizing for conversion and user experience Positive client feedback on design quality and strong collaboration with cross-functional team members Responsibilities Create campaign emails, automated flow templates, and promotional designs aligned with client brand guidelines Develop mobile-first email designs that render flawlessly across email clients and devices Collaborate with retention strategists and copywriters to bring campaign concepts to life Iterate quickly on email designs based on performance data and A/B test results Maintain organized design systems and asset libraries for each client account Build reusable email modules and components that streamline production Ensure all emails meet accessibility standards and deliverability best practices Stay current on email design trends, platform updates, and industry innovations Execute QA testing across multiple email clients before campaign launches Support the team with design feedback and contribute to internal design standards Manage multiple client accounts with varying design needs and brand aesthetics Requirements 2-4 years of experience in email design, digital design, or related field with a strong portfolio demonstrating email work Expert proficiency in Figma for designing email layouts and creating design systems Strong grasp of email marketing best practices including mobile optimization, CTA placement, and visual hierarchy Demonstrated ability to design for conversion while maintaining brand integrity and aesthetic quality Fast iteration speed with ability to produce high-quality work under tight timelines Excellent attention to detail and commitment to pixel-perfect execution across devices Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with strategists, copywriters, and account teams Familiarity with direct-to-consumer brands and ecommerce customer lifecycle marketing Nice to Have Hands-on experience with Klaviyo or other email service platforms (Mailchimp, Iterable, Braze) Motion graphics or animation capabilities to enhance email interactivity and engagement Experience designing for SMS, push notifications, or other retention marketing channels Understanding of email deliverability factors and how design choices impact inbox placement Compensation and Benefits Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Remote m&a lawyer - brazil
description: About Moritz Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match. We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work. We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team. Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart. The Role Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's M& A work in Brazil: share and asset deals, mergers, carve-outs, and joint ventures for clients ranging from startups to midsize companies. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of SPAs and APAs, disclosure schedules, warranties and indemnities, and ancillary transaction documents. Run legal due diligence, coordinate specialist workstreams (tax, employment, IP, regulatory), and manage the transaction timeline through signing and closing. Advise on deal structuring, earn-outs and deferred consideration, W& I insurance, closing mechanics, and post-closing matters. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA. What You'll Bring 5+ years practising M& A or corporate law in private practice or in-house. End-to-end deal experience. You've led transactions from term sheet through closing, not just supported workstreams. Deep familiarity with transaction documents — SPAs, APAs, disclosure letters, warranty and indemnity regimes, and completion mechanics. Due diligence command. You can scope, run, and synthesize a diligence exercise into findings a buyer can act on. Cross-border fluency. Comfortable coordinating with counsel in other jurisdictions on multi-country deals. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements. Why Moritz Run deals with modern tooling — faster diligence, cleaner documents, and clients who value speed and certainty. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure. Frequently Asked Questions How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz? Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client. What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform? Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding. Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network? No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work. How are co-counsel matched to client matters? Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Business development & marketing

Key responsibilities 1. Business Development & Partnerships – approximately 70% Map, prospect and develop relationships with private and public free-to-air broadcasters, telecommunications operators, digital and OTT platforms, distributors, technology companies, payment providers, retailers, consumer brands and other strategic partners. Build and maintain an organized pipeline of potential partners in Brazil and other Latin American markets, documenting contacts, opportunity stages, next steps, risks and timelines. Prepare presentations, commercial proposals, preliminary partnership models, meeting minutes, progress reports and decision-support materials. Lead initial meetings, identify partner needs and develop value propositions suited to different cooperation models. Support negotiations involving content distribution, licensing, revenue sharing, subscription bundles, media/barter, co-marketing, customer benefits, promotions and other commercial models. Negotiate commercial terms within approved parameters and coordinate validation with the Country Manager and relevant i QIYI functions; final approvals and signatures remain with management and headquarters. Coordinate the progress of opportunities with internal content, marketing, product, technology, legal, finance, operations and other teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia. Support partnership implementation after approval, ensuring alignment on scope, deliverables, timelines and performance indicators. Conduct research on markets, competitors, potential partners and trends across streaming, television, telecommunications and entertainment in Latin America. Represent i QIYI in partner meetings, industry events and business visits, with availability for occasional travel within Brazil and Latin America. 2. Marketing Partnerships – approximately 30% Identify and structure marketing opportunities with commercial partners to promote the i QIYI brand, priority content launches and subscription offers. Plan and coordinate co-marketing initiatives, partner campaigns, events, activations, content promotion and online/offline promotional projects. Adapt global briefs and materials to the needs of Brazil and other Latin American markets, ensuring local relevance and compliance with brand guidelines. Coordinate deliverables with internal and external stakeholders, including partners, agencies, public relations teams, influencers and vendors when applicable. Track execution and results, gather evidence of delivery and prepare reports with learnings and recommendations. Required qualifications At least 3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, commercial roles, partnership marketing or related functions. Hands-on experience in B2 B prospecting, relationship management, proposal preparation and follow-up of negotiations or partner projects. Fluent or native Portuguese. Professional English, with the ability to participate in meetings, prepare presentations and communicate with international teams. Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, set priorities, meet deadlines and keep stakeholders informed. Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, organization and relationship-building skills. Availability to collaborate across time zones and travel occasionally within Brazil and Latin America. Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, International Relations, Economics or a related field. Proficiency in Power Point/Google Slides and Excel/Google Sheets; familiarity with CRM and project-management tools is preferred. Preferred qualifications Experience in streaming, entertainment, television, media, telecommunications, technology or digital platforms. Professional Spanish for communication with partners across Latin America. Existing relationships with broadcasters, telecom operators, platforms, agencies, brands or other potential partners. Experience working in multicultural environments and with international headquarters or regional teams. Knowledge of licensing, revenue-share, subscription bundles, co-marketing and media/barter models. Mandarin Chinese. Experience working with Chinese companies and a strong understanding of Chinese corporate culture will be considered a distinct advantage. Employment conditions and benefits Permanent CLT employment agreement. Initially remote work, with the possibility that the work model may be reviewed in the future, including hybrid or office-based arrangements, in accordance with business needs, company policy and applicable law. Quarterly bonus in accordance with company policy and individual/corporate performance. Health insurance plan, meal/food allowance and life insurance. 30 calendar days of paid annual leave, 13th-month salary, FGTS, INSS and other statutory benefits under Brazilian law. Applicable statutory leave and occupational health examinations.

title: Cozinheiro(a)
description: Venha viver nosso propósito! Na Hyatt, somos movidos pelo propósito de "cuidar das pessoas para que elas possam ser o seu melhor". Acreditamos que as falhas existem e são elas que nos levam ao sucesso mais cedo; · Prezamos por umambiente de descontração, rimos alto e geramos a alegria em nosso ambiente de trabalho. Cultivar um ambiente saudável, alegre e de bem estar é a chave para um serviço de excelência! Garantir a qualidade, apresentação e consistência dos alimentos servidos. Executar atividades de produção, pré-preparo, cocção e montagem dos pratos. Monitorar o armazenamento, conservação e validade dos insumos. Cumprir as normas de higiene, segurança alimentar e boas práticas de manipulação de alimentos. Apoiar o controle de desperdícios e a utilização adequada dos ingredientes. Organizar e manter limpas as áreas de trabalho, equipamentos e utensílios. Colaborar com a equipe de cozinha para assegurar uma operação eficiente e um excelente atendimento aos hóspedes. Participar da produção para restaurantes, room service, eventos, banquetes e demais serviços gastronômicos do hotel. Contribuir com sugestões de melhorias nos processos e na apresentação dos pratos. Experiência prévia como Cozinheiro(a), preferencialmente em hotéis, resorts, restaurantes de alto padrão ou gastronomia premium. Conhecimento de técnicas culinárias, manipulação de alimentos e controle de qualidade. Familiaridade com normas de segurança alimentar e vigilância sanitária. Disponibilidade para trabalhar em escala, incluindo finais de semana e feriados. What you'll do Hold statutory director responsibility for business conduct and operations at a BCB-authorised VASP, with personal accountability for acting in good faith and in the company's best interest Oversee and conduct the institution's day-to-day business activities, ensuring alignment with Gate's commercial strategy and operational objectives in Brazil Act as the primary operational interface between Gate's Brazil entity and its regional and global leadership, translating strategic direction into local execution Maintain personal fitness and propriety; disclose, without prompting, anything that touches your fitness, propriety, or potential conflicts — to the company and to the BCB Drive the VASP authorisation process forward on the business and operations workstream, including declarations and documentation the BCB requests on its own timeline Discharge any additional duties prescribed by applicable Brazilian laws, regulations, or by the company What you'll bring Must-have Brazilian permanent residency or citizenship , with the ability to maintain ordinary residency in Brazil for as long as the role requires You hold no competing statutory director or officer seat at another regulated entity in Brazil A predominantly commercial and operational profile — you have led or co-led a business unit, market expansion, or operational function, not just supported one Prior experience at a BCB-regulated financial institution, fintech, or crypto/VASP — familiarity with how regulated entities operate in Brazil is essential Fluent in Portuguese and English, written and spoken Willing to undergo a full BCB fit-and-proper review and disclose what it requires Nice-to-have Prior experience in the crypto or digital asset industry Direct prior engagement with BCB on regulatory filings, inspections, or authorisation processes Academic background or postgraduate training in business, finance, economics, or law

title: Promo writer (brasil)
description: Promo Writer Location: Remote Position Type: Contract Company: Pocket FM About Us At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series. Role Overview As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution. The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance. You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads. Key Responsibilities 1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series. Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance. Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series. Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production. Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series. 2. Adaptation & Localization Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese. Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience. Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market. Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts. 3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity. Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments. Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction. Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards. 4. Production-Ready Script Delivery Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required. Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute. Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed. Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution. 5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement. Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization. Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos. Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance. 6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams. Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines. Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets. Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response. 7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization Use Gen AI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement. Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards. Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength. Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content. Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences. Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese. Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers. Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred. Ability to write production-ready scripts with clear directions for voice-over and post-production teams. Ability to analyze feedback and performance signals to improve creative output. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality across multiple deliverables. Comfortable working in a fast-paced content and performance marketing environment. Familiarity with AI-based writing, translation, or content adaptation tools is a plus. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller who understands how to turn an audio series into a compelling promotional experience. They should know how to grab attention quickly, build emotional curiosity, create drama, and write scripts that make audiences want to listen further. They should be equally comfortable writing original promo scripts, adapting English ads into Brazilian Portuguese, refining existing scripts, and suggesting creative reworks for ads that are not performing well.

title: Remote investment lawyer - brazil
description: About Moritz Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match. We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work. We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team. Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart. The Role Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's venture and investment work in Brazil: seed and growth equity rounds, SAFEs and convertible instruments, term sheets, shareholder agreements, and secondaries. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of investment documentation for founders, startups, angels, and funds — on both the company side and the investor side. Run legal due diligence, manage closing processes and conditions precedent, and coordinate signing and completion. Advise on cap table structuring, employee option plans (ESOPs), governance and board matters, and investor rights. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA. What You'll Bring 5+ years practising venture capital, private equity, or corporate finance law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with investment documentation — term sheets, subscription and shareholders' agreements, SAFEs and convertible notes, and articles / constitutional documents. Both-sides experience. You've acted for companies and for investors, and you know where each side's real risk sits. Fluency in startup economics. Liquidation preferences, anti-dilution, vesting, option pools — and how they interact across rounds. Speed with precision. Venture deals move fast; your documents still close cleanly. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements. Why Moritz Work with ambitious founders and funds on deals that move fast — supported by tooling that keeps pace. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure. Frequently Asked Questions How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz? Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client. What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform? Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding. Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network? No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work. How are co-counsel matched to client matters? Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms.

title: Remote litigation lawyer - brazil
description: About Moritz Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match. We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work. We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team. Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart. The Role Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's dispute resolution work in Brazil: commercial contract disputes, shareholder and post-M& A disputes, technology and IP disputes, debt recovery, and arbitration. Lead case strategy, pleadings, evidence, and procedural steps for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies. Advise clients on litigation risk before disputes arise — contract audits, escalation strategy, settlement positioning, and dispute resolution clauses. Draft and negotiate letters before action, settlement agreements, and standstill and tolling arrangements; represent clients in mediation, arbitration, and court proceedings where licensed to do so. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA. What You'll Bring 5+ years practising commercial litigation or arbitration in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with contract disputes — breach, termination, damages, limitation of liability, and injunctive relief. Advocacy and procedure. Confident managing proceedings end-to-end, with rights of audience or substantial arbitration experience (ICC, LCIA, or local institutions). Strong drafting under pressure. Pleadings, witness statements, and settlement terms that hold up. Commercial judgment. You know when to fight, when to settle, and how to explain the difference to a client. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements. Why Moritz Bring modern tooling to dispute work — faster case preparation, sharper strategy, and clients who value clarity over billable churn. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure. Frequently Asked Questions How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz? Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client. What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform? Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding. Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network? No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work. How are co-counsel matched to client matters? Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Data specialist (with advanced english)
description: About Us: Yipit Data is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475 M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1 B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. About the Role: We’re currently working on expanding our Central Data Team to increase our product portfolio with members who build, create and maintain our data products. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply. The Data Specialist plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs . Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Specialist works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. See this short video to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current Data Specialists love working here! As Our Data Specialist, you will: Take ownership of high-impact work with guidance — whether that’s running or building data products end-to-end, supporting centralized data ingestion pipelines the broader team relies on, or building clean, granular data feeds that help clients dive into data. Work with massive amounts of data to answer our clients’ key questions about the companies we cover and datasets we analyze. You’ll learn our proprietary methods and techniques, building the judgment and mental models to understand why our data works — not just how to produce it. Use AI and tooling to accelerate your learning and work — assisting with queries, investigations, debugging, and repetitive tasks. You’ll develop the habit of validating AI-generated outputs rather than assuming correctness, building a foundation for using AI effectively throughout your career here. Become a trusted resource for internal stakeholders and clients , working with them to identify and answer key questions. You’ll contribute to data feeds, custom analyses, and reports consumed by the top investors in the world. Improve the products, pipelines, and data feeds you own — we value curiosity and experimentation, and we expect you to follow established best practices while also questioning the status quo and identifying opportunities for improvement. Learn or sharpen SQL, Python, and Py Spark skills starting with our two-month new hire training program covering technical fundamentals as well as our internal tools and processes. You Are Likely To Succeed If: You have a strong ownership mentality — you want to ensure our products are the best in the world and take personal responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks You have strong attention to detail and produce work with minimal errors You communicate clearly, both orally and in writing — including proactively sharing progress, blockers, and updates You strive to make tasks as efficient as possible and are excited about using AI and tooling to work smarter You can manage multiple priorities and stay organized You are experimental and curious — energized by learning and not afraid to change the status quo You are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company What We Offer: Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary: We care about your personal life and we mean it. We offer vacation time, team events and more! Your growth at Yipit Data is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at Yipit Data is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) Personal laptop Health and wellness package Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia/Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Retail credit risk manager
description: About Revolut People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution. About the role Risk at Revolut operates across all functions, products, and regions to monitor front-line performance and ensure the business operates safely. They’re among the first to be involved in new initiatives, from tech to customer support. We’re looking for a Risk Manager who'll support growing our retail credit portfolio. You'll make data-driven decisions on risk-adjusted return requirements and lead preventive and reactive actions that impact portfolio credit performance and profitability. Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch. What you'll be doing Overseeing exposure to retail credit risk Working with the Risk Modelling team to design, develop, and implement retail credit risk models Managing risk appetite through limit calibration and monitoring Maintaining key policies, procedures, and controls Engaging with first-line businesses to identify, monitor, and govern emerging retail credit risks, including new product risk assessments Engaging with key stakeholders, committees, and regional regulators on material retail credit risk exposures and limit governance Quantifying risk exposures within the organisation, taking into consideration stakeholder impact Protecting the company from excessive risk-taking, saving on both short and long-term costs Building trust and reputation with our external stakeholders and ensuring risks are managed within the risk appetite Identifying emerging risks that require immediate attention or could threaten long-term viability What you'll need Experience in consumer credit risk within a financial institution, bank, asset management, payment institution, and/or related services firm Knowledge of key lending products, like credit cards, personal loans, buy now-pay later, and/or mortgages A quantitative background in STEM (science, technology, engineering, and mathematics), statistics, economics, or related fields Fluency in English Nice to have Experience in the second line of defence (risk) Impressive programming skills using Python, R, and/or SQL Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D& I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team. Important notice for candidates: Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles. • Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment. • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an@ domain. We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. title: Senior ai agent engineer
description: About First Ignite First Ignite makes software for university tech transfer offices. Those are the people who take research coming out of a university lab and get it patented, licensed, or spun out into a company. The role We're hiring a Senior AI Agent Engineer. You'll build the agents in our product, and you'll build the evals that tell us whether each change made them better or worse. The work is document-heavy rather than chat. The agents run multi-step, call tools, read long and inconsistently formatted source material, check it against existing records, and produce output that a person reviews before anything happens with it. Accuracy matters more here than speed or novelty. Most of the engineering effort goes into precision, traceability, and getting the agent to hand off to a human at the right moment. You'll report to the Head of Engineering and work with product and the full-stack team. If you've shipped agents before, you've probably had the experience of changing a prompt and having no idea whether you improved anything. That problem is most of this job. What you'll do • Design and ship long-running, multi-step, tool-using agents on various AI SDKs and tooling, included but not limited to the Open AI Agents SDK, the Anthropic Agent SDK, the Vercel AI SDK, Lang Graph, MCP, and Temporal Cloud. • Wrap our APIs and our partners' APIs as tools an agent can call over MCP. Some of those systems are old, single-tenant, and outside our control, so a fair amount of the work is translation. • Get structured data out of long documents and match it against records that already exist. Expect entity resolution and fuzzy matching, and expect much of it to run in batch. • Stand up eval suites using various evaluation frameworks and tooling, included but not limited to Promptfoo, Braintrust, Lang Smith, Deep Eval, LLM-as-judge methods, and custom harnesses. Measure tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and whether the agent finished the task. • Every agent here produces a draft that a person signs off on. Build the citations and confidence signals that make that review fast, and give the agent a clear way to escalate. • Sit with product and domain experts and turn vague quality goals into something measurable. Sometimes the only dataset available for that is tiny, or confidential, or both. • Instrument production traffic, turn real customer interactions into golden datasets, and run them as regression tests. • Compare models against each other (Open AI, Anthropic, open-weight), along with prompt strategies and agent designs, and know what each option costs in latency and quality. • Bootstrap quality signal for features that have no production traffic yet. That usually means generating synthetic documents and test cases, including the ugly edge cases real customers will eventually send us, and knowing where synthetic data stops being a good proxy. • Write the templates, docs, and tooling the rest of the team needs to run evals without coming to you. Required Qualifications: • 3+ years of engineering experience, including hands-on work on LLM or agent systems that real users touched. • You've evaluated agents, not only models, and you know why single-turn accuracy says little about a multi-step run. • You've integrated against APIs you don't own, including old ones with bad documentation, and turned them into something an agent can call reliably. • You're comfortable with document pipelines: pulling data out, normalizing it, and checking it against a structured source of truth. • You've used at least one LLM evaluation framework, in-house tooling included. • You know how LLM-as-judge methods break down (position bias, verbosity bias, judge drift) and what to do about it. • You can tell a real regression from noise, and design an experiment that answers the question being asked instead of a nearby one. • You can read a customer call transcript, work out which failures matter, and ship a fix and an eval for them. • You write clearly. Engineers won't act on eval results they don't read or don't trust. • You're based somewhere between New York time (ET) and Western European time. Italy is the furthest east we can go. You might currently be titled AI Agent Engineer · Agentic AI Engineer · Senior AI Engineer · AI Systems Engineer · Lead AI Developer · AI Solutions Architect · AI Integration Specialist · Senior Data Scientist, AI Titles are all over the place in this space. If the work above matches what you already do, apply. We'll go on what you've shipped. Preferred Qualifications: • You've evaluated retrieval systems: RAG, hybrid search, reranking. • You've worked with agent orchestration frameworks like Temporal, Lang Graph, or the Open AI Agents SDK, and you know how long-running tool use goes wrong. • You have a background in information retrieval or search relevance. • You've worked somewhere an agent's output carried financial or compliance consequences. • You've built internal tooling that non-engineers used on their own to label and review model output. This is a fully remote, full-time permanent position available to candidates located within the New York (ET) through Western Europe time zones, with flexible working hours to support collaboration across regions.

title: Data specialist (with advanced english)
description: About Us: Yipit Data is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475 M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1 B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. About the Role: We’re currently working on expanding our Central Data Team to increase our product portfolio with members who build, create and maintain our data products. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply. The Data Specialist plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs . Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Specialist works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. See this short video to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current Data Specialists love working here! As Our Data Specialist, you will: Take ownership of high-impact work with guidance — whether that’s running or building data products end-to-end, supporting centralized data ingestion pipelines the broader team relies on, or building clean, granular data feeds that help clients dive into data. Work with massive amounts of data to answer our clients’ key questions about the companies we cover and datasets we analyze. You’ll learn our proprietary methods and techniques, building the judgment and mental models to understand why our data works — not just how to produce it. Use AI and tooling to accelerate your learning and work — assisting with queries, investigations, debugging, and repetitive tasks. You’ll develop the habit of validating AI-generated outputs rather than assuming correctness, building a foundation for using AI effectively throughout your career here. Become a trusted resource for internal stakeholders and clients , working with them to identify and answer key questions. You’ll contribute to data feeds, custom analyses, and reports consumed by the top investors in the world. Improve the products, pipelines, and data feeds you own — we value curiosity and experimentation, and we expect you to follow established best practices while also questioning the status quo and identifying opportunities for improvement. Learn or sharpen SQL, Python, and Py Spark skills starting with our two-month new hire training program covering technical fundamentals as well as our internal tools and processes. You Are Likely To Succeed If: You have a strong ownership mentality — you want to ensure our products are the best in the world and take personal responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks You have strong attention to detail and produce work with minimal errors You communicate clearly, both orally and in writing — including proactively sharing progress, blockers, and updates You strive to make tasks as efficient as possible and are excited about using AI and tooling to work smarter You can manage multiple priorities and stay organized You are experimental and curious — energized by learning and not afraid to change the status quo You are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company What We Offer: Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary: We care about your personal life and we mean it. We offer vacation time, team events and more! Your growth at Yipit Data is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at Yipit Data is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) Personal laptop Health and wellness package Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia/Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você . Necessário: Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Qc analyst - audio content - brazil
description: About Us Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens. At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact. Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide. Role Overview As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives. Key Responsibilities 1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval. 2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration. 3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble 4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback. Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions. 5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines. 6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards. 7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows. 8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology 9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content. 10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible. Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements. Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork. Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis. Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

title: Remote real estate lawyer - brazil
description: About Moritz Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match. We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work. We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team. Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart. The Role Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's real estate work in Brazil: commercial leases, sale and purchase agreements, real estate aspects of corporate transactions, and development and construction agreements. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of leases and property transaction documents for clients ranging from startups taking their first office to enterprises managing property portfolios. Run title review and property due diligence, including for real estate elements of M& A and financing transactions. Advise on real estate financing and security, planning and zoning questions, and landlord-tenant matters. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA. What You'll Bring 5+ years practising commercial real estate law in private practice or in-house. Leasing depth. Office, retail, industrial, and flexible-space leases — rent review, service charges, repair obligations, break options, and assignments. Transactional experience. Sale and purchase agreements, title review and due diligence, conditions, and completion mechanics. Financing familiarity. Mortgages, security packages, and the real estate workstreams of corporate deals. Practical judgment. You separate the points that protect the client from the points that stall the deal. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements. Why Moritz Bring speed and clarity to real estate transactions traditionally slowed by process. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure. Frequently Asked Questions How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz? Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client. What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform? Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding. Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network? No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work. How are co-counsel matched to client matters? Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Senior fpga developer
description: About the Company : Working for a global provider of network test, monitoring and assurance solutions for telecommunications, cloud, enterprises, first responders, military, aerospace, and railway. A leader in light management technologies for 3 D sensing, anti-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, industrial, automotive, government and aerospace applications. Employees working on this project are passionate about supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company – to question, to collaborate and to push for solutions that will delight our customers. About the Role : We are seeking a Principal/Staff-level FPGA Engineer — a recognized technical authority — to own FPGA architecture for our state-of-the-art Communications Test & Measurement products. Responsibilities : The successful candidate will define and drive end-to-end FPGA architecture, including make/buy tradeoffs on IP, floorplanning and timing closure strategy for multi-gigabit designs, and DFX approach, using Verilog/System Verilog/VHDL and industry-leading simulation, synthesis, place-and-route, and formal/UVM verification tools. This person will serve as the final technical escalation point for FPGA design and debug issues across the team, mentor other FPGA engineers, and lead root-cause debug of silicon and board bring-up issues that could not be resolved elsewhere. Qualifications : BS or MS degree in Electrical and/or Computer Engineering with a minimum of 12-15 years of relevant experience, including at least 5+ years specifically architecting and closing timing on multi-Gbps Ser Des/transceiver-based FPGA designs. Required Skills : Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing high-speed FPGA designs using Verilog/System Verilog and/or VHDL required. Deep, hands-on expertise with FPGA transceivers, hard IP, and PLLs — including timing closure, equalization, and link debug at multi-Gbps rates — required (not incidental exposure). Demonstrated experience closing timing and debugging link-layer issues on high-speed Ethernet (10 M to 1.6 T) and IP protocol stacks in production designs. Proven expertise with optical interfaces and modules (SFPs, QSFPs) in shipped products. Deep working knowledge of VLANs, MPLS, VPLS, and Voice/Video over IP (Vo IP, IPTV). Extensive experience with AMD or Altera FPGA devices and their full implementation toolchains, including advanced timing closure and floorplanning techniques. Proven experience with formal verification and/or UVM-based verification methodologies, not limited to directed testbenches. Demonstrated track record of taking FPGA designs from architecture through volume production, including systems-level tradeoffs across the HW/FW boundary. Version control experience using Git or similar tools. Exceptional written and oral communication skills, including the ability to mentor engineers and communicate architecture decisions with stakeholders across the world. Exceptional analytical and organizational skills, with an uncompromising commitment to accuracy and technical rigor in a fast-paced product environment. Preferred Skills : Languages: English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Remote litigation lawyer - brazil
description: About Moritz Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA. What You'll Bring 5+ years practising commercial litigation or arbitration in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with contract disputes — breach, termination, damages, limitation of liability, and injunctive relief. Advocacy and procedure. Confident managing proceedings end-to-end, with rights of audience or substantial arbitration experience (ICC, LCIA, or local institutions). Strong drafting under pressure. Pleadings, witness statements, and settlement terms that hold up. Commercial judgment. You know when to fight, when to settle, and how to explain the difference to a client. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements. Why Moritz Bring modern tooling to dispute work — faster case preparation, sharper strategy, and clients who value clarity over billable churn. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure. Frequently Asked Questions How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz? Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client. What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform? Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding. Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network? No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work. How are co-counsel matched to client matters? Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

What you will do Handle incoming and outgoing crypto transfers, conversions between assets, and movement of funds between wallets and exchange accounts.
