Job Purpose The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will participate in the Neurodegeneration Computational Fellows Training Program (NDCF) at Howard University, developing and applying computational skills in neuroscience research. Under the mentorship of host labs, the fellow will contribute to analyzing datasets related to neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, or traumatic brain injury (TBI), advancing the understanding of disease mechanisms. This role supports the program’s mission to train researchers in advanced mathematics, data analysis, and bioinformatics for neurodegeneration research. Supervisory Authority This position has no supervisory authority. The fellow will work directly under the supervision of a principal investigator or mentor in a host lab affiliated with the NDCF program, receiving guidance on research tasks and computational training. Nature And Scope The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will engage in interdisciplinary research within a host lab at Howard University or a partner institution, such as NIH/NINDS, focusing on computational approaches to neurodegeneration. The fellow will gain hands-on experience analyzing neurophysiological, genomic, or imaging data using tools like Python, R, or machine learning frameworks. The fellow will collaborate with researchers, other fellows, and faculty, participating in lab meetings and NDCF symposia. The role is designed to support professional growth by developing skills in data analysis and contributing to research publications. External opportunities may include presenting at conferences or collaborating with partners in the Neurodegeneration Challenge Network (NDCN) under the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative. Principal Accountabilities Assist in analyzing datasets (e.g., MRI, genomic, or microbiome data) using computational tools under the guidance of a mentor, identifying patterns or biomarkers in neurodegenerative diseases. Learn and apply statistical or machine learning methods to support research on disease mechanisms, following lab protocols. Support data processing tasks, such as image analysis or sequence alignment, using provided software or scripts. Prepare research summaries and present findings at NDCF symposia, lab meetings, or external conferences. Contribute to team discussions, collaborating with lab members to integrate computational and experimental findings. Maintain accurate records of research activities and adhere to ethical standards in data handling and reporting. Core Competencies Computational Aptitude: Basic familiarity with programming (e.g., Python, R) or data analysis tools, with a strong interest in learning advanced computational techniques. Analytical Thinking: Ability to approach complex datasets with curiosity and apply structured methods to derive meaningful insights under mentorship. Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams, including researchers, students, and faculty. Communication: Clear written and verbal communication to present research progress and engage with scientific audiences. Adaptability: Eagerness to acquire new skills and adapt to evolving research tools and methodologies in a training-focused environment. Minimum Requirements Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in neuroscience, biology, computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field. Experience: Some exposure to programming, data analysis, or neuroscience research through coursework, internships, or personal projects. No prior expertise required. Skills: Basic familiarity with computational tools (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, or command-line interfaces) or a strong interest in learning these skills. Introductory knowledge of statistics or data visualization is a plus. Other: Demonstrated interest in neurodegeneration research and the ability to work collaboratively under mentorship guidance. Adjust and modify inspection practices and programs shall be reflected based on such modifications and perform special studies in corrosion control. Experiência: Projetos geotécnicos na área de estruturas de contenções, estabilidade de taludes, tratamento de aterros sobre solos moles e fundações. Desejável experiência em BIM. title: Generative AI Video Creator & Editor
description: Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community. We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey. About the Role We are seeking for a hands on AI Video Creator who will spend the majority of their time developing, generating, and refining AI driven video content. This role is centered on generative video production. The ideal candidate is deeply fluent in AI video tools and capable of transforming raw AI outputs into polished, brand ready, performance driven content through strong editing and post production skills. What You\'ll Do Daily generate high fidelity AI video assets primarily focused on “human realistic” using leading generative platforms Design visual concepts, scenes, and sequences using text to video and image to video tools Iterate rapidly through prompts and workflows to refine outputs Edit and refine AI generated footage into polished deliverables Own post production for smaller projects including editing, color, and sound (not incl. final sweetening/mixing) Integrate AI generated content with live action footage when needed Collaborate with creative and strategy teams to ensure outputs align with brand and performance goals Build repeatable AI production workflows Stay ahead of emerging AI video and generative media advancements Required AI Video Platforms Experience Runway Gen 3 OpenAI Sora Google Veo/Nana Banana Kaiber Supporting AI & Post Production Tools Adobe Firefly Midjourney ElevenLabs Topaz Video AI Adobe Premiere Pro After Effects DaVinci Resolve What You Bring 5 years of video production experience, with demonstrated hands-on use of AI video tools in a corporate, agency or educational environment Passion and commitment to winning through hard work while having some fun along the way (in creative, in business, in life) Ability to be both entrepreneurially minded and collaborative as part of dynamic team Strong editing and post production skills Ability to turn rough generative outputs into polished brand ready assets Understanding of pacing, storytelling, and visual composition Comfort working in a fast paced, high iteration environment Strong eye for brand appropriateness and performance marketing objectives Curiosity and deep interest in generative media Company Benefits Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases. Generous paid-time-off policy Flexible working hours Work remotely Continuing education, training, conferences Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business. You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry! If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Executivo(a) de Vendas II - Rio de Janeiro, RJ
description: Executivo(a) de Vendas II - Rio de Janeiro, RJ Sales Rio de Janeiro Full-time Brazil Descrição da vaga Promove e vende os produtos da empresa dentro de uma área geográfica, gerenciando a carteira de clientes em maior parte complexos (ex.: redes e contas chaves) que podem exigir contrato e controle de contrapartidas para atingir metas significativas de vendas/receita. Avalia as necessidades dos clientes e sugere produtos, conforme diretriz por canal; responde a consultas mais complexas de clientes e tem autonomia para negociar preços e prazos de entrega dentro dos limites autorizados. Propõe plano de ação baseado nos alinhamentos com áreas de suporte, análise dos concorrentes e financeiras com base em P&L para reagir às mudanças e tendências de mercado e às exigências dos clientes. Desenvolve JBP de médio e longo prazo para clientes-chave, monitora e adapta os movimentos de vendas para que os objetivos sejam atingidos. Estabelece planos de vendas trimestrais, mensais ou semanais, prioriza e planeja suas próprias atividades para que as metas sejam atingidas. Participa do desenvolvimento dos planos de negócios de clientes a médio prazo e otimiza recursos para maximizar o crescimento da categoria. Trabalha com outras áreas para alcançar os resultados esperados. Desenvolve múltiplas alternativas de negociação e pode avaliá-las de forma aberta e justa. Identifica e descobre novas necessidades e variáveis dos clientes e da JDE e as usa para soluções dentro de limites planejados. Treina outros em como aplicar o processo de negociação e pode liderar uma negociação complexa. Qualificações Formação superior completa em Administração, Marketing, Economia ou áreas correlatas; Experiência comprovada como Executivo de Vendas ou Key Account Executivo no segmento de alimentos, bebidas ou bens de consumo (FMCG); Vivência em negociação com varejo, redes regionais e Key Accounts; Forte perfil analítico, domínio de Excel e PowerPoint (Pacote Office avançado); Capacidade de planejar, analisar resultados e agir com foco em performance, e estratégias comerciais, foco em execução, planos e loja. Informações adicionais Contamos com um programa de benefícios flexíveis em que você poderá personalizar seus benefícios de acordo com seu momento e estilo de vida. Assistência Médica; Assistência Odontológica; Previdência Privada; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Desconto de Produtos; Remuneração variável; Programa Grãos do Futuro (assistência e licença estendida para famílias gestantes e adotantes); Plano de Saúde Pet. Nossa declaração de Diversidade Equidade & Inclusão Na JDE Peet's, nosso propósito é criar um futuro melhor, no qual servimos, refletimos e abraçamos todos em suas autenticidades. Acreditamos na promoção de uma organização mais diversa, equitativa e inclusiva, em que todos se sintam confortáveis para serem, verdadeiramente, quem são e possam despertar todo o seu potencial. Isto significa que não toleramos qualquer tipo de discriminação com base em raça ou etnia, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica diversa e protegida por lei. Ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida dos associados, priorizamos DE&I no centro dos nossos processos de pessoas. Isso nos permite promover o respeito e eliminar qualquer preconceito ou ação discriminatória, garantindo uma experiência inclusiva no ambiente de trabalho. Não hesite em entrar em contato se precisar de qualquer suporte durante o processo de recrutamento. Nossos esforços nessa agenda nos renderam o prestigioso Prêmio Catalyst e a Certificação Fair Pay Leader 2025, reconhecimento pelo nosso compromisso com a equidade salarial, refletido em uma diferença de gênero global de apenas 0,52%. #DesperteSuasPossibilidades #UmaXícaradeMomentosIncríveis Descrição da empresa Quem somos nós? Somos a JDE Peet’s. Nós produzimos um café para cada xícara e desenvolvemos marcas para cada coração. A JDE Peet’s é a principal empresa global dedicada exclusivamente ao café, servindo aproximadamente 4.400 xícaras de café por segundo em mais de 100 mercados. Guiados pela nossa estratégia “Reviver o Incrível”, focamos em um crescimento liderado por marcas com três grandes apostas: Peet’s, L’OR e Jacobs, além de um portfólio de 9 ícones locais, como Douwe Egberts, Kenco, Pilão, Old Town, Moccona, Super, Gevalia, Friele e Marcilla. Em 2024, a JDE Peet’s gerou 8,8 bilhões de euros em vendas e contava com mais de 21 mil colaboradores no mundo todo. No Brasil, somos uma das maiores empresas de café e temos atuação nacional através de nossas marcas Pilão, L’OR, Café do Ponto, Damasco, Café Maratá, Caboclo, Café Pelé, Café Puro, Chá Maratá e Chá Castelari. Como é trabalhar na JDE Peet's? Acreditamos que é incrível o que acontece ao redor de uma xícara de café. Juntos, criamos esses momentos todos os dias, transformando ideias em impacto e possibilidades em realidade. Na JDE Peet’s, trabalhamos como um só time, guiados por nossos valores: Ouse Encantar, Seja Dono, Simplifique e Vencer Juntos. Aqui, você encontra liberdade para inovar, coragem para dar passos ousados e apoio para desenvolver sua carreira em um ambiente global. Venha fazer parte do nosso time e descubra qual é a sua xícara de momentos incríveis! #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Recruiter - International Desk
description: About Us Pacifica Continental is an international recruitment consultancy that provides different services focused on talents to impact companies’ business all over the world. We provide a young and dynamic environment and by being result-oriented our main goal it's to deliver outstanding solutions for all of our clients. Our customized solutions and consultative approach ensure we select the best talent in the market and our operations have reached over 50 countries, including more than 250 cities around the world. We pride ourselves on working with precision and expertise in a wide range of industries! Our DNA Ambition - We are guided by excellence, we push for progress and not perfection. Connection - We believe that people are the real drive of our company. Global Mindset - We value diversity and believe that we are enriched by it. Ownership - We take responsibility for our actions. At Pacifica, you will have plenty of opportunity to grow and assist in the development of others. We connect well-being and professional development. Position Overview As an International Desk Recruiter, you will play a crucial role in managing a team and overseeing various processes within the organization. Your responsibilities will include effective team management, coordination, and leadership to achieve desired goals and outcomes. Responsibilities Manage the end-to-end recruitment process (headhunting) for the United States, Canada, and Europe, focusing on middle management, executive roles, and board-level positions. Serve as the key point of communication throughout the hiring process, handling client relationships and maintaining seamless interactions. Collaborate with the CEO and stakeholders to align recruitment goals with the overall business objectives. Stay updated on market trends, industry insights, and talent acquisition best practices to enhance the recruitment process and deliver exceptional results. Qualifications Bachelor's degree completed in Psychology, Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field. Proven experience in end-to-end recruitment processes, including headhunting, for international markets (United States, Canada, Europe). Advanced English proficiency. Experience recruiting for middle management, executive, and board-level positions, with a successful track record. Strong problem‑solving, decision‑making, and multi‑priority management skills to meet deadlines. Proficiency with recruitment tools, applicant tracking systems, and relevant software. Proactive mindset and awareness of industry trends to bring innovative talent‑acquisition solutions. Strong communication and interpersonal skills for effective client relationships and stakeholder collaboration. What we offer Competitive Salary Performance bonus Meal Voucher and Grocery voucher (VA and VR) Totalpass Health and Dental Insurance – SulAmérica Saúde Life Insurance Transportation Voucher Notebook and mobile – other tools for home office may be provided on demand Hybrid work model If you are a proactive and results‑driven recruiter, passionate about finding the best talent globally and contributing to the growth of a multinational organization, we would love to hear from you. Join our dynamic team at Pacifica Continental and make an impact on the world of talent acquisition. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: EC/Fiocruz contrata Especialista Sênior em Captação de Recursos e Parcerias
description: O Escritório de Captação de Recursos da Fundação Oswaldo Cruz (EC/Fiocruz) está contratando Especialista Sênior em Captação de Recursos e Parcerias para atuar de forma estratégica na mobilização da sustentabilidade financeira de projetos institucionais. O candidato precisa ter, no mínimo, oito anos de experiência em captação de recursos e na elaboração de projetos para editais, além de atuação prévia com incentivos fiscais e prospecção de editais públicos e privados. description: Com experiência em gestão de negócios, desde 1955, a WLM atua no segmento automotivo e no agronegócio. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania , como caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, na prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada. A sua holding está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e possui uma filial corporativa em Minas Gerais, na Cidade de Contagem. Vem acelerar a sua carreira com o Grupo WLM! Sua missão: Executa reparos de baixa complexidade como manutenções preventivas, serviços de freios, serviços elétricos, eliminação de vazamentos e afins. Auxilia na elaboração de planos de manutenção, nas manutenções de motores, sistemas e partes de veículos automotores. Realiza serviços de lubrificação dos veículos utilizando bomba de lubrificação em eixos, quinta roda, sistema direcional, embuchamento e suspenção de acordo com a demanda especifica de cada veículo (preventiva e corretiva).
